title: I would definitely buy again!
text:
I would definitely buy again!. These curtains are beautiful! They look high end for the price.
However, they are a bit too sheer for use in a bedroom so I returned them.
I really wanted to keep them.

product_metadata.title: Aside Bside Victorian Design Sheer Curtain Luxurious Pattern Embroidered Rod Pocket Top Window Decoration for Living Room Bedroom and Office (2 Panel, W 50 x L 84 inch, Blue)
features: Features: Luxurious pattern embroidered design, sheer curtains, good transmittance.
Material: Linen blended. Machine wash cold, gentle cycle, easy care, do not bleach.
Rod pocket panel is easy to hang with a standard or decorative curtain rod.
Notice:The price is for one Panel
Good for living room, kitchen, bedroom, kids room, etc.
